irregularities.title: Physical purity stamp and maker’s mark are not verified
irregularities.finding: No readable, item-specific physical purity-stamp plus maker’s-mark evidence was verified on the official listings. Product photography was not treated as hallmark proof.
irregularities.action: Request close-up, item-specific hallmark photographs and inspect the delivered piece. A karat stamp alone is not proof; independently verify before the return window closes.
irregularities.sourceBasis: Absence finding after line-by-line review of every officialProductUrl in research/candidates.json.

irregularities.title: Listed weight does not establish net metal weight
irregularities.finding: The six listings state a gram weight and warn that sizing can change it. They do not state whether gemstones are included in that weight.
irregularities.action: Keep netMetalWeightGrams blank. Any karat/24 calculation must be labeled nominal listed-weight math, never actual raw-gold content or a valuation.
irregularities.sourceBasis: Each affected candidate's listedWeightGrams and listedWeightBasis evidence in research/candidates.json.

irregularities.title: Explicit solid-gold wording and gram weight are absent
irregularities.finding: These official pages state karat and gold color, but the audit did not find explicit solid-gold wording or a gram weight. Karat wording alone was not promoted to a solid-gold claim.
irregularities.action: Leave solidGold and all weight fields blank. Obtain written solid-gold confirmation and a metal-only weight for the exact configuration.
irregularities.sourceBasis: Absence finding after line-by-line review of every affected officialProductUrl in research/candidates.json.

irregularities.title: URL slug and official item number differ
irregularities.finding: The official URL slug ends in 70845, while the official page and item specifics identify item 71345.
irregularities.action: Use item 71345 in seller correspondence and confirm the item number on the invoice and appraisal before payment.

irregularities.title: Displayed base price is not the price of every size
irregularities.finding: These official pages display size-specific surcharges next to the base price.
irregularities.action: Do not treat the base price as a final configured quote. Recheck the exact size, metal color, stone and final total before payment.
irregularities.sourceBasis: Each affected candidate's priceUsd and priceBasis evidence in research/candidates.json.

irregularities.title: Some settings include a different prong metal
irregularities.finding: Blue Nile item 500000y14 lists platinum prongs. Brilliant Earth style BE1199H6-18KY lists 14K white-gold prongs on an 18K yellow-gold setting.
irregularities.action: Do not apply one karat fraction to an entire future weight. Request component-level metal weights or have a jeweler assess the actual piece.
irregularities.sourceBasis: Each affected candidate's style evidence in research/candidates.json.

irregularities.title: USD selector conflicts with euro price
irregularities.finding: The official Six-Prong Petite 14K page displayed USD in the selector but €720.00 as the setting price and showed EUR in the currency controls.
irregularities.action: Excluded from the USD catalog. No currency conversion or USD relabeling was performed. Recheck the official checkout currency manually before any future inclusion.
irregularities.quote: USD; six-prong petite comfort fit 1.5mm solitaire-€‌720.00; €‌720.00(Setting Only); EURCADAUDGBP

irregularities.title: BBB search summary was not reproducible on the direct profile
irregularities.finding: A discovery search summary exposed a letter grade and complaint counts that the direct BBB profile did not reproduce. Direct pages confirmed non-accreditation and the complaint counts recorded in research/sellers.json, but did not expose a letter grade.
irregularities.action: The letter grade remains blank and unverified. Search snippets are excluded as evidence; manually review the live BBB profile.
irregularities.quote: This business is NOT BBB Accredited.

irregularities.title: Seller policy discusses chargebacks and disputes
irregularities.finding: TraxNYC's policy says initiating a chargeback instead of following its return process violates purchase terms and that it may submit records to contest disputes.
irregularities.action: Read the clause and card issuer terms before payment. This dashboard records the seller wording and makes no legal conclusion about cardholder rights.
irregularities.quote: Customers agree that initiating a chargeback or payment dispute in lieu of following this Returns & Refunds Policy constitutes a violation of purchase terms.

irregularities.title: Return clock can start before delivery
irregularities.finding: Brilliant Earth's policy starts the return/exchange timeline when the purchase is available for shipment or pickup, not upon delivery.
irregularities.action: Get the exact start date in writing and arrange independent inspection immediately after delivery; do not assume 30 days from receipt.
irregularities.quote: Please note our return and exchange policy timelines begin when your purchase is available for shipment or pickup.

irregularities.title: The calculator's gold reference is a dated snapshot, not a live quote
irregularities.finding: The calculator reference is the Kitco Live GoldPrice panel at Oct 22, 2026 - 19:11 NY Time (bid $4,025.00 per troy ounce, displayed $129.41 per gram). An independent gold-api.com spot read on 2026-10-23T23:38:16Z published 3996.899902 USD per troy ounce (128.50 per gram). Both are stored with their own publisher timestamps in research/policy/market.json.
irregularities.action: Read the timestamp next to any gold figure before using it. The calculator prints the named Kitco panel and its timestamp and never blends the two readings; re-open the official page before relying on a melt figure, and remember melt value is a floor, not a price.
irregularities.sourceBasis: research/policy/market.json (source and liveFeed), each with a publisher timestamp.

irregularities.title: Blue Nile item 195639 has been repurposed to a different ring
irregularities.finding: Read live on 2026-10-23T23:41Z, the official item-195639 URL sells 'Petite Solitaire Engagement Ring in 14k Yellow Gold', Stock Number 501130y14, Metal 14K Yellow Gold, Width 1.80mm, $1,000 (Setting Price) — which is this row. The canonical 71-row dataset on the dashboard root held a different ring at the same item number ('Petite Micropave', 1.50 mm, platinum prongs) and withdrew that row as a source mismatch (root flag F65). A seller may reuse an item number or URL for a different product.
irregularities.action: Never trust an item number or URL alone. Re-open the official page immediately before ordering and check the product name, stock number and width against what you intend to buy; keep the listing text with the receipt.
irregularities.quote: Stock Number 501130y14; Metal 14K Yellow Gold; Width 1.80mm; $1,000(Setting Price)

irregularities.title: A seller's strikethrough 'compare at' price is not evidence of value
irregularities.finding: The seller's own product feed for item 70689 publishes price 300000 ($3,000) beside compare_at_price 570000 ($5,700). The larger figure is a seller-set marketing reference; it was read on 2026-10-23T23:46Z and is deliberately not stored as a catalog value.
irregularities.action: Judge price against the ring's published gold weight and the current gold price, not against a strikethrough figure. No discount claim on this dashboard is based on a compare-at price.

irregularities.title: The machine-readable weight field is shipping weight, not gold weight
irregularities.finding: Read on 2026-10-23, the seller's own product feeds carry a variant weight field of 3 or 4 grams (and 0 on some yellow-gold variants of item 66233) while the seller's own prose states the metal weight: item 71345 'on 14K gold at 2.80 grams', item 71851 'the ring weighs 3.00 grams', item 66233 'The ring weighs 3.20 grams'. The feed field is the parcel/shipment weight. Three stored weights (70689 3.8 g, 70589 2.9 g, 70114 2 g) appear only in the product page spec table and not in the feed.
irregularities.action: Never read a platform weight field as gold weight. Only a weight the seller states for the piece, with its basis disclosed, is used here — and a listed weight is still not a verified net metal weight.
irregularities.sourceBasis: data/session-7d64f506/live-reads-2026-10-23.json: feed weight fields versus the seller's own gram statements for the same products.

irregularities.title: Two published dashboards beside the root are bounded, dated snapshots
irregularities.finding: Besides the canonical dashboard at the site root, GitHub Pages also serves /site/ (this 13-row official-source review, re-read 2026-10-23) and /docs/ (a 14-row dashboard dated 2026-10-22 whose gold anchor is dated 2026-10-21 at $4,024.36 per troy ounce and where 7 of 14 prices are marked unverified). Neither is the full catalogue.
irregularities.action: Treat /site/ and /docs/ as dated evidence snapshots. For the full verified catalogue use the dashboard root, and always re-open the seller's own page before ordering.
irregularities.sourceBasis: site/index.html, docs/index.html and data/rings_c2bbe753.json as published on GitHub Pages.

irregularities.title: A dormant first-pass generator could overwrite the published dashboard
irregularities.finding: tools/build_site.py (the first-pass generator, dormant since 2026-10-22) had OUT set to the repository root and listed index.html, flagged.html and calculator.html among the pages it writes — the same filenames as the canonical published dashboard. Running it would have overwritten 71-row pages with 14-row pages.
irregularities.action: Fixed on 2026-10-23 (board T50): the script now refuses to write to the repository root and requires an explicit --allow-regenerate flag; its default output is docs/. No generated page was overwritten by this change.
irregularities.sourceBasis: tools/build_site.py before and after the 2026-10-23 change in this branch.
